title: Danny Sheehan says he has coordinates for an underwater UFO base
summary: Marik von Rennenkampf tells of Danny Sheehan says he has coordinates for an underwater UFO base, about c. 2024 at Off Baja California / Guadalupe Island area, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Off Baja California / Guadalupe Island area

tellings.quote: he said that he has coordinates for a UFO underwater base.

plain: A witness named Marik von Rennenkampf, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2025, says that a man named Danny Sheehan told him, around 2024, that he has map coordinates for an underwater UFO base. The place is linked to the waters off Baja California in Mexico, near Guadalupe Island. If true, it would mean something non-human is operating under the sea near North America.
